-- src/com/acme/BAcmeAnon.java --
package com.acme;
public class BAcmeAnon extends BComponent {
  public void started() throws Exception { schedule(); }
  // the outer class's started() does not cover an anonymous body of the same type: LG2
  Object child = new BAcmeAnon() {
    public void stationStarted() throws Exception { refresh(); }
  };
  // an anonymous body with its own started(): clean
  Object both = new BComponent() {
    public void started() throws Exception { schedule(); }
    public void stationStarted() throws Exception { refresh(); }
  };
  // a second anonymous body of that type is another class: the started() above does not cover it, LG2
  Object other = new BComponent() {
    public void stationStarted() throws Exception { reload(); }
  };
}

package com.acme;
